title: Objective-to-Outcome Roadmap Conductor: dynamic initiative alignment and escalation
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem statement: At company scale we have >120 initiatives per quarter across product, infra, and GTM. Current OKR->roadmap linking is manual, brittle, and frequently drifts: owners update tasks in isolation, dependencies surface late, and execution teams lack a single view of which deliverables materially move a company objective.

Goal: Build a lightweight orchestration layer (Roadmap Conductor) that makes company-level objectives first-class in Linear, continuously surfaces initiative-to-OKR links, detects alignment drift, suggests owners and escalation lanes, and produces an operationalized release fence for cross-functional rollouts. The conductor is not a full PMIS — it's an assistive layer to reduce mismatches between stated objectives and delivered outcomes.

Success criteria (90 days):
- 80% of company objectives have at least one verified initiative link in Linear (link verification can be manual or via heuristics).
- 50% reduction in time-to-detect high-risk cross-team dependency (measured as median days from dependency introduction to detection).
- Pilot with 2 program-level initiatives (runtime-1.18 rollout + console-observability rewrite) with alignment score >= 8/10 from stakeholders.

Scope & constraints:
- Phase 1: Read-only conductor that reads OKRs from canonical sheet/Confluence and maps to Linear issues using heuristics (title/label/topic overlap, owner matching).
- Phase 2: Add lightweight feedback loop (PM approves mapping, can flag false positives), dependency heatmaps, and automatic escalation triggers when milestone slip or capacity mismatch detected.
- Must interoperate with existing release calendar and gating (release field), and respect Private/Dedicated product confidentiality (no data exfiltration).

Approach & technical notes:
1) Mapping heuristics: fuzzy title match, label overlap, and owner/email heuristics. Provide a confidence score per mapping to allow human review.
2) Alignment Score: compute blend of linked deliverables coverage, milestone parity, and dependency density. Stored as an attribute on PM issues (readable via Console).
3) Escalation policy engine: simple ruleset (e.g., if alignment score < 5 and critical dependency unresolved > 7 days, notify program lead + eng oncall).
4) UI: a small Console panel and a Linear view: "Objective Conductor" that surfaces mapped initiatives, confidence, and next action.

Milestones & timeline:
- Discovery & data model definition: 2 weeks (owner: Marco Li)
- Prototype mapping engine + confidence metric (PoC): 3 weeks (owner: Eng infra lead)
- PM review UI wireframe + acceptance flow: 2 weeks (owner: Design)
- Pilot rollout for two initiatives: 4 weeks
- Iteration and org-wide rollout plan: 3 weeks

Stakeholders: ["Aisha Patel (PM)","Marco Li (TPM)","Renee Ortiz (Design)","Diego Fernandes (Eng Lead)","Sasha Kumar (Platform)"]

Risks & mitigations: 
- Risk: False mappings will undermine trust.
  Mitigation: Show confidence, require PM verification before write actions, and keep phase 1 read-only.
- Risk: Too many alerts/false escalations.
  Mitigation: Start with conservative thresholds and add throttling + escalation reviewers.
- Risk: Ownership ambiguity across infra/product/console.
  Mitigation: Add a required "primary initiative owner" field for all mapped links; surface owner conflicts in UI.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Conductor lists mapped initiatives for at least 6 company objectives and provides confidence scores.
- PM verification flow implemented and tested with pilot stakeholders.
- Escalation triggers and notification templates drafted and approved.

Notes / open questions: 
- Where is the canonical single source of truth for company OKRs? (Product thinks Confluence, Strategy prefers a Google Sheet) — decision needed before build.
- How do we measure alignment score rigorously (signal design to be coordinated with Research/Applied ML for weighting)?

Next steps: 
- Align on canonical OKR source (Aisha) by 2025-02-14.
- Kick discovery with Eng infra and Design (Marco to schedule)
